description: This file defines a utility function `normalizeRows` that processes CSV data rows by mapping headers to a canonical schema, parsing date formats, coercing string values to numbers, and normalizing certain metrics such as tickets and adherence percentages. It serves as a data transformation utility within a React-based frontend project.

methods.name: normalizeRows(rows = [])
methods.description: Converts raw CSV rows to a canonical schema with coercion and date parsing.
